You can add your character's costumes and sound clips to add to your character to the game!

If you set the "Seconds per run frame:" to an empty input, the interval will be faster than 0 seconds (Which in this case is 2 frames).

You can also add as many Ouch voice clips and footstep sounds, just make sure to apply the changes to this custom block above.

If your character's costumes are too big or too small compared to the grey box costumes provided, you can use the "Size:" input to adjust the size of your character without affecting any hitboxes.
